findings.description: The policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on every resource to the deployment user. Compromise of credentials for this user enables broad data access and modification, and the EC2 and Lambda permissions can support privilege-escalation paths through roles or instance profiles the user is permitted to use.

The generated IAM secret access key is exposed through an output that is not marked sensitive. This can disclose the credential in Terraform CLI output and other output consumers; using encrypted_secret does not make the output sensitive by itself.
